remarks: Great opportunity to make this cute Colonial in the highly desirable Riverside section of Greenwich your own. Featuring 4 bedrooms and 1.5 baths, including a convenient first-floor bedroom, this home offers a flexible layout with plenty of space to update and customize to your style. The dining room flows into the kitchen, and a one-car garage provides added convenience. Set on public water and sewer, the property also includes a private backyard, ideal for outdoor living. With its prime location near schools, shopping, parks, and transportation, this home is the perfect canvas to renovate and create your dream residence in one of Greenwich's most sought-after neighborhoods.
